queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Paint.NET' AND publisher = 'dotPDN LLC';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Paint.NET' AND publisher = 'dotPDN LLC' AND version_compare(version, '5.1.12') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'paint.net.exe');
